argv:
import pathlib, shutil, subprocess, tempfile
N = chr(10)
src = pathlib.Path('tests/run-tests.sh').read_text(encoding='utf-8')
assert 'python3 tests/test-' not in src and 'bash tests/test-' not in src, 'the manual test-file list is still in run-tests.sh'
assert 'run_test_files' in src.splitlines(), 'the full suite does not call run_test_files at top level'
tmp = pathlib.Path(tempfile.mkdtemp())
try:
    (tmp / 'tests').mkdir()
    (tmp / 'scripts').mkdir()
    shutil.copy('tests/run-tests.sh', tmp / 'tests/run-tests.sh')
    shutil.copy('scripts/harness-path.sh', tmp / 'scripts/harness-path.sh')
    shutil.copy('CHANGELOG.md', tmp / 'CHANGELOG.md')
    def run():
        done = subprocess.run(['bash', 'tests/run-tests.sh', '--files-only'], cwd=tmp, capture_output=True, text=True, stdin=subprocess.DEVNULL, timeout=120)
        return done.returncode, done.stdout.splitlines()
    code, lines = run()
    assert code == 1 and '  FAIL : test discovery found test files' in lines, ('empty', code, lines)
    (tmp / 'tests/test-pass.py').write_text('print(1)' + N)
    (tmp / 'tests/test-pass.sh').write_text('exit 0' + N)
    code, lines = run()
    assert code == 0 and '  ok   : tests/test-pass.py' in lines and '  ok   : tests/test-pass.sh' in lines, ('baseline', code, lines)
    cases = (('test-new-fail.py', 'raise SystemExit(3)', '  FAIL : tests/test-new-fail.py'), ('test-new-fail.sh', 'exit 4', '  FAIL : tests/test-new-fail.sh'), ('test-broken.py', 'def (:', '  FAIL : tests/test-broken.py is valid Python'), ('test-broken.sh', 'if then', '  FAIL : tests/test-broken.sh is valid bash'), ('test-notes.txt', 'notes', '  FAIL : tests/test-notes.txt is a .py or .sh test'))
    for name, body, want in cases:
        path = tmp / 'tests' / name
        path.write_text(body + N)
        code, lines = run()
        assert code == 1 and want in lines, (name, code, lines)
        path.unlink()
    code, lines = run()
    assert code == 0, ('restored', code, lines)
finally:
    shutil.rmtree(tmp)
print('ok')
